text: You can drop off your completed California mail ballot at any polling place in the state, even outside your home county.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Voter Bill of Rights
truthSource.oneLine: California’s Voter Bill of Rights includes the right to drop off your completed vote-by-mail ballot at any polling place in California.

lesson.tip: The Secretary of State points you to a drop box in your own county, which is where the “county only” idea comes from. Polling places are different: any one in California takes your ballot. Check which kind of site a rule is about.
